author: Rusty McMurray / Soulshine (Tulsa, OK); built by Claude at his direction
preserves: v1.1 as run (prereg e8f2b93c...69fc, receipt fc6b84da...4b50, reproduced bit-identically 2026-10-15 on numpy 2.5.3/scipy 1.18.1). world.py and v1_readers.py byte-identical to v1.
defect_addressed: v1.1 reopen_check tests only regions OUTSIDE the hold footprint with a sign test at alpha .01; fewer than 7 outside regions can never pass (2^-6 > .01), so a footprint of >=10 of 16 regions is absorbing (ChatGPT review 2026-10-10, crafted probe). At lambda 128 early looks also fail persistence because the 42-day span still contains pre-onset days, and the re-hold footprint covers most of a well-fed terrain.

change.only_the_reopening_rule_changes: look(), states, need definition, encounter schedule, cost proxy and scoring are unchanged from v1.1.
change.hold_day: when an item enters HELD at day h, record h. A re-hold after a reopened look records the new h.
change.new_evidence_requirement: a HELD item is checked at a need only once at least 14 days (one BLOCK) of evidence have arrived after h. Before that, no check is made and none is counted.
change.check: NEW EVIDENCE ONLY, WHOLE TERRAIN: window W = days h+1..d. Baseline = each region's own rate over the history used by the look that produced the hold (days before h-41). (a) spread: sign test over ALL eligible regions (>=5 messages in W and in baseline) that W excess over baseline is positive, p < 0.01; (b) persistence: pooled W excess over pooled baseline, one-sided z > 2.326. Both required.
change.footprint: still computed and recorded at every hold, for reporting only. It no longer gates the check.
change.pressure_alone_never_reopens: pooled excess (b) is never sufficient; positional spread over the whole terrain on new evidence (a) is required.
change.if_fires: a full look the same day, exactly as v1.1.

cost_accounting: as v1.1: R+3 per full look; eligible regions per reopening check.

experiments.PROBE: ChatGPT's absorbing-footprint probe (n=100 everywhere; k=10, days 57-62 k=90, day 63+ k=50; encounters every day), reproduced verbatim

predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P0_lockout_probe: v1.2 on the probe ends PROPOSED (v1.1 ends HELD with 0 reopens).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P3_positional_confounds: COMMUTE <= 15 and DINNER <= 15, at lambda 32 and at lambda 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P4_difficult_month: WINDOW <= 20 at lambda 32 and <= 54 at lambda 128 (no worse than v1.1).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P5_held_confounds_stay_held: among COMMUTE and DINNER streams HELD at first look, share ever reopened <= 0.05, each family, at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P6_action: macro action accuracy (GENUINE, COMMUTE, DINNER, WINDOW, NULL) >= 0.8478 at lambda 32 (v1.1) and >= 0.8738 at lambda 128 (v1 TERRAIN, which v1.1 lost to).
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P8_information_limit: COLOCATED vs GENUINE two-proportion |z| < 3 at lambda 32 and 128.
predictions_exact_counts_out_of_300.P9_cost: MAIN mean full looks <= 0.1 x v1 TERRAIN looks, and mean region evaluations <= 0.25 x v1's (v1.1's P1/P1b, unchanged).

mutation_lane.M1_pressure_only_reopen: reopen on (b) alone. Must raise held-COMMUTE reopen share above 0.05 at lambda 32, i.e. be caught by P5.
mutation_lane.M2_old_evidence: use the full 42-day span instead of post-hold evidence in the check. Reported: reopen counts and GENUINE/WINDOW proposals vs v1.2.
mutation_lane.M3_polling: look every day under pressure: reads per stream >= 3x v1.2.

reporting_rule: Every prediction reported PASS or FAIL as frozen, with exact counts. No change after the first full run; any change is v1.3 with this preserved.
